Before you head out Getting around, staying safe, and final tips

Pins show approximate locations; confirm your destination before heading out. Tours, experiences without a fixed meeting point, and recommendations we’re still putting together stay in the lists below.

Downtown is walkable, and CTA buses and trains connect many parts of the city. Taxis and rideshare services are also available. Stay aware of your surroundings, keep valuables secure, and choose well-lit, populated routes at night. Plan your return before heading out. For transit safety tips, visit the CTA safety page, opens in a new tab.

Book popular restaurants, rooftop spots, tours, and attractions ahead. Group nearby activities by neighborhood, wear comfortable walking shoes, and check the July forecast. You don’t need a packed itinerary to enjoy Chicago — make the weekend your own!

Confirm attraction hours, tickets, tour meeting points, and transit routes before you go. For routes and fares, visit the Chicago Transit Authority, opens in a new tab.

We’re so happy you’re making the trip to celebrate with us. We hope you enjoy exploring the city, and we can’t wait to see you!
